name: shopware-demo/split-shipment
description: Ship one order to several addresses: per-destination deliveries, shipping charged once or per destination, and line-item tax by each destination's location.

description.en-GB: Lets buyers ship one order to several of their addresses. Each destination becomes its own delivery, shipping can be charged once or per destination, and tax follows each destination's location.
description.de-DE: Eine Bestellung an mehrere Adressen liefern, mit Versandkosten pro Ziel und Steuer nach Lieferort.
